notes: P2-05 honesty correction: no model has been trained or validated for this release. Accuracy metrics (MAPE, R2, Kendall tau, held-out sample, segment performance, feature importance) are intentionally omitted — no training code or corpus is committed to the repository, so any such numbers would be unverifiable. This artifact defines the calibration SCHEMA only. A validated release requires a reproducible pipeline (see docs/work-plan item P2-05, Option A / Phase 36).
knownLimitations: No predictions artifact is published; the predictions API returns 503 (release-data-unavailable).
No held-out validation has been performed against ECO2 or any ground truth.
